comparison_to_preserved_baseline.legacy_replay_csv: Deprecated replay microbenchmark excluded; current manuscript TCP evidence was rerun in all 14 specified arms.

data_inputs: scikit-learn bundled Diabetes and Wisconsin Diagnostic Breast Cancer datasets only; synthetic data regenerated from script seeds

figures.figure1: Fresh generator output is the single-panel block schematic. The historical archived figure was a two-panel layout not produced by the delivered generator; manuscript caption is synchronized to the fresh single-panel output.

interpretation_limits: TCP execution uses two processes on one host and an application-level added-delay model; this is not a physical multi-machine network measurement.
Each split/metric/profile has one timed run, and metric order is fixed; timing summaries do not separate split variation from measurement noise or order effects.

The breast-cancer repeated splits use a fixed penalty selected in the original analysis; subsequent test partitions can overlap original tuning observations, so these repeats assess optimizer robustness rather than independent validation of penalty selection.
meaning: One fresh, complete manuscript experiment run; existing raw outputs were not copied into the run directory.

postprocessing.scope: One explanatory table-template footnote, after all numerical stages finished.
